item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["8b24b4cb96688979807f","ae1acd2c90805a0b718e","dcd841775fab7459a209"],"operation":"Parse a four-component OBJ v line through ParseFromString and publish vertex_weights.","condition":"The v line has a fourth component.","capability":"Preserve that component as a dedicated vertex weight in vertex_weights.","consequence":"The fourth component is lost or is not published as a vertex weight.","equivalence_reason":"All three describe the same vertex-weight parsing and output behavior."},{"member_ids":["8223b9b9211883698acc","a90ba499dcabf01f784a","4ca573f4c056f4f2f934"],"operation":"Parse an OBJ vertex through ParseFromString with config.vertex_color=false.","condition":"The vertex has no RGB components and vertex-color fallback is disabled.","capability":"Accept the vertex while leaving fallback colors absent.","consequence":"The vertex is rejected or fallback colors are supplied.","equivalence_reason":"All three target the same disabled-fallback vertex behavior."},{"member_ids":["0e87590cf03d76f5fedf","05a946dded8ffaa7454b","e27058163c43296c596c"],"operation":"Export a polygon face through ParseFromString with config.triangulate=false.","condition":"A valid polygon, including a quad, is supplied with triangulation disabled.","capability":"Preserve the polygon as one face with its original vertices.","consequence":"The polygon is triangulated instead of retained as one face.","equivalence_reason":"All three target the same nontriangulated polygon export behavior."}]}
